name: Sri Shiva Temple
town_description: Nellore, on the banks of the Penna river in southern coastal Andhra Pradesh, is the headquarters of Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore district. A historic rice-trading and aquaculture centre, it is known for its ancient Vaishnavite and Shaivite temples, including Talpagiri, Jonnawada and Narasimhakonda.

travel.airport: Tirupati International Airport, about 170 km away.
travel.railway: Nellore railway station, about 2-3 km away, on the Chennai-Vijayawada line.
travel.road: In central Nellore (Santhapet/Chinna Bazar area), reachable by auto-rickshaw from the bus stand and railway station; on NH-16.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for comfortable weather in Nellore.
